description: This file defines an interface 'ThingSearchSudoCommandResponse' that aggregates responses for sudo commands related to 'thing-search' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It mainly declares constants, default method implementations, and method signatures related to resource path, resource type, entity, and headers.

classes.name: ThingSearchSudoCommandResponse
classes.description: An interface representing responses for sudo commands in the 'thing-search' context, providing default behaviors for resource path, resource type, and setter methods for entity and headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating no specific resource path is needed for sudo commands.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with ThingSearchSudoCommand responses.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity data for the response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the response.
